purpose: Single-product page with a bespoke, highly visual two-section body (animated hero + one very tall narrative crop) instead of the standard product-page benefit-narrative repeat. Treated as its own minimal template per the scope guidance rather than forced into product-page.
notes: realtime is the shortest measured section sequence of any product-family route (4 landmarks vs. 6-8 elsewhere) and uses custom 'HeroCrop'/'Crop' components; modeled here as hero-narrative + a single very tall workflow-feature-panel rather than inventing a one-off section type.
